title: Kummer Term Mate
statement: For a commuting square i q = π s, define the base-change map as the adjunct of the pulled-back actual direct-image counit. Define the direct-image composition comparison by conjugate adjunctions. The full-to-punctured map is direct image of the actual open adjunction unit; a normalized punctured-term isomorphism composes with that very map to the base-change mate. Built from [def-sfb-normalized-kummer-comparison], [def-sfb-profinite-coefficient-linearization], [def-sfb-condensed-point-pullback-comparisons], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].
